mapper.sql: id, platform_provider_connection_id AS connection_id, platform_provider_connection_revision AS revision, model_code, display_name, model_type, array_to_string(capabilities, ',') AS capabilities, context_window, output_limit, embedding_dimension, last_verification_id AS verification_id, verification_expires_at AS expires_at, status, version, created_at, parameter_source, residency, rerank_candidate_limit, array_to_string(planned_tenant_ids, ',') AS planned_tenant_ids, candidate_discovery_id AS discovery_id, candidate_display_name, candidate_classification AS classification, declared_by_subject_id AS subject_id, declared_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM model_runtime.platform_model_deployment WHERE id = #{id} AND scope = 'PLATFORM'

SELECT verification.probed_at FROM model_runtime.platform_model_deployment deployment JOIN model_runtime.platform_model_capability_verification verification ON verification.id = deployment.last_verification_id WHERE deployment.id = #{id} AND deployment.scope = 'PLATFORM'

SELECT count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'DRAFT') AS drafts, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'VERIFIED') AS verified, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED') AS published, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'DISABLED') AS disabled FROM model_runtime.platform_model_deployment WHERE scope = 'PLATFORM'

SELECT connection.id FROM model_runtime.platform_provider_connection connection WHERE connection.id = #{id} AND connection.scope = 'PLATFORM' AND connection.version = #{revision} AND connection.status = 'VERIFIED' AND connection.last_probe_succeeded = TRUE AND connection.last_probed_at <= #{now} AND connection.last_probed_at > CAST(#{now} AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_runtime.platform_provider_connection_publication publication WHERE publication.connection_id = connection.id AND publication.connection_revision = connection.version) FOR SHARE OF connection
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_runtime.platform_model_deployment (id, scope, platform_provider_connection_id, platform_provider_connection_revision, model_code, display_name, model_type, capabilities, context_window, output_limit, embedding_dimension, status, version, created_at, parameter_source, residency, rerank_candidate_limit, planned_tenant_ids, candidate_discovery_id, candidate_display_name, candidate_classification, declared_by_subject_id, declared_at) VALUES (#{d.id.value}, 'PLATFORM', #{d.providerConnectionId.value}, #{d.providerConnectionRevision}, #{d.modelCode}, #{d.displayName}, #{d.modelType}, string_to_array(#{capabilities}, ','), #{d.contextWindow}, #{d.outputLimit}, #{d.embeddingDimension}, #{d.status}, #{d.version}, #{d.createdAt}, #{d.inputs.parameterSource}, #{d.inputs.residency}, #{d.inputs.rerankCandidateLimit}, string_to_array(#{tenants}, ',')::BIGINT[], #{d.inputs.discoveryId}, #{d.inputs.candidateDisplayName}, #{d.inputs.classification}, #{d.inputs.declaredBySubjectId}, #{d.inputs.declaredAt})
